summary: Discord music autoplay no longer repeats the same few songs: autoplay skips any track already played in the current session.
details: Autoplay reseeds one-at-a-time from whatever just finished, and YouTube's Mix only ever excludes its own seed -- so a long autoplay chain drifted into repeating the same few tracks of one Mix neighborhood.

MusicPlayer now keeps a session-scoped, in-memory set of locators that actually started playing (_played_locators, recorded in _advance and resume_from_persisted right before the stream starts). Autoplay's pick selection skips anything already in it and takes the next fresh track from the Mix instead.
A Mix whose every entry has already played falls through to the ordinary idle behaviour exactly like an empty one -- never retried, never substituted with a guess.
User-requested playback is never deduped: the played-history set is read only by the autoplay pick path, so /music play of a song already played still plays it.
limitations: The played history is session-scoped and in-memory: a restart (or deploy) begins a fresh window, so a track played before a restart can be autoplayed again after it.
The Mix is still reseeded one track at a time from whatever most recently played -- a multi-track lookahead queue remains deferred.
